stem: What happens next in this passage after “The process changed how they saw leftovers.”?
options: After the activity, the students did not just see trash as dirty things.
At first, students thought it was just a flower bed.
It was just a place no one had tried.
Banana peels and vegetable ends were no longer just trash.
